manifest_row.title: Climate Activists Disrupt UK Newspaper Deliveries

screening.main_topic: Extinction Rebellion's disruption of newspaper deliveries and the resulting debate about press freedom and public access to news.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change is a meaningful part of the activists' stated motive: they sought action on environmental issues and argued that newspapers inadequately report on the climate emergency. Political responses also connect a free press with the fight against climate change.
screening.reason: The article primarily covers the blockade, its effects on newspaper distribution, and reactions concerning press freedom. Climate change informs the protest and appears in the surrounding debate, but is not the article's central subject.
